description: This is a PHP unit test double (fake) for the CalendarSyncOrchestrator class within the SuiteCRM project. It is used for testing calendar synchronization behavior by simulating operations, recording calls, and allowing failure injection.

classes.name: FakeCalendarSyncOrchestrator
classes.description: A fake implementation of CalendarSyncOrchestrator for testing purposes that records operations and can simulate success or failure.

methods.name: setShouldSucceed
methods.description: Configures the orchestrator to succeed or fail on sync operations.

methods.name: syncAllCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Simulates syncing all calendar accounts, records the call, and can simulate failure.

methods.name: syncCalendarAccount
methods.description: Simulates syncing a specific calendar account, records the call, and can simulate failure.

methods.name: syncEvent
methods.description: Simulates syncing a calendar event, records the call, and can simulate success or failure.

methods.name: getSyncedOperations
methods.description: Returns the list of recorded sync operations.

methods.name: getSyncedAccounts
methods.description: Returns the list of recorded calendar account syncs.

methods.name: wasSyncCalled
methods.description: Returns true if any sync operation or account sync was called.

methods.name: wasSyncEventCalled
methods.description: Returns true if any event synchronization was called.

methods.name: wasSyncAccountCalled
methods.description: Returns true if any account synchronization was called.

methods.name: getLastOperation
methods.description: Returns the most recent sync operation record.

methods.name: getLastAccount
methods.description: Returns the most recent account sync record.

methods.name: getOperationCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of sync operations performed.

methods.name: getAccountSyncCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of account syncs performed.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all recorded data and default success/failure setting.
